description: Price trajectory and order-book snapshots of a resolved Polymarket or Kalshi market during the 1 to 72 hours before it resolved (default 24 h). Only markets with at least 3 price points in the window are served (otherwise not charged): find them with prediction_search_markets and resolved_before_cutoff: true. Get the market id from prediction_search_markets (free). Data is delayed by at least 24 hours (independently recorded from the public Polymarket and Kalshi APIs; not affiliated). Price: $0.01 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

hours.description: Length of the window that ends at the resolution, in hours: integer from 1 to 72. Default: 24.

id.description: Market id: numeric Polymarket id (e.g. 559651) or Kalshi ticker (e.g. KXELONMARS-99); 'polymarket:<id>' / 'kalshi:<ticker>' also accepted

platform.description: Platform: polymarket or kalshi (lower case). Optional, default: inferred from the id (numeric id = polymarket, otherwise kalshi); ignored when the id is prefixed with 'polymarket:' or 'kalshi:'.

name: prediction_market_pre_resolution
title: Prediction market trajectory before resolution
